result.topic_en: Lecture-style notes on the meridian circle (transit instrument): its divided circle, reading microscopes and their carriers, the level (Libelle), elimination of eccentricity and division errors by opposite microscopes, determination of the nadir point with a mercury horizon, and corrections for refraction and flexure.
